name: The Jablowme Brothers

tenures.source: the fed's own served Champions page (promotions/ubf/archive/champions.html); the fed's own served Roster page (promotions/ubf/archive/roster.html) independently corroborates Heywood Jablowme and Sherwood Jablowme as tag-team partners
tenures.note: The fed's own served Champions page names "The Jablowme Brothers" as the reigning Bloodfest Tagteam Champions without naming its two members individually; the fed's own served Roster page separately identifies Heywood Jablowme and Sherwood Jablowme as tag-team partners -- the two documents together identify the pairing. Does not appear on the fed's own served Fridaynight Warfare card.
